newsitem.title: GREECE: Seven Albanian soldiers seek asylum in Greece.
newsitem.headline: Seven Albanian soldiers seek asylum in Greece.

text.p: Seven Albanian soldiers requested political asylum in Greece on Thursday, a Greek defence ministry spokesman said.
Spokesman Dimitris Katsoulis said that the soldiers would be considered political refugees until the foreign ministry and the public order ministry decided whether to grant them asylum.
Katsoulis had no details on where the soldiers had turned themselves over to Greek authorities or the circumstances. But he said they had all been on active duty in Albania.
They were the first Albanian soldiers known to have asked for asylum in Greece since rebels clashed with the Albanian army earlier this week.

An Albanian military plane landed in Italy on Tuesday and two pilots asked for asylum. Albania has been in chaos since the collapse of fraudulent saving schemes and troops are enforcing emergency rule to try to put down violence in the south near the Greek border.
